page.title: Automation — Pranav PT
page.description: What is automation really? Learn how systems do work without human input — from scheduled tasks to AI-powered workflows.

sections.headline: Automation is just a system doing what you'd do — without you.
sections.subheadline: It's not robots. It's not magic. It's logic that runs on a schedule or a trigger. And once you get it, you'll want to automate everything.

sections.title: What is automation — in plain language?
sections.body: Automation is setting up instructions in advance so that a computer can do them without you being there. Think of it like a vending machine. You don't need a human to hand you a snack — the machine knows: if button A4 is pressed, dispense this item, take this payment. Automation is exactly that. Triggers and actions. If this happens, do that.

visual.description: Trigger → condition → action flow diagram, clean and simple

cards.title: Scheduled Automation
cards.description: Run something at a fixed time. Every day at 9am, send a report. Every Monday, back up the database.

cards.title: Trigger-Based Automation
cards.description: When something happens, do something else. A form is submitted → send a welcome email → add to CRM.

cards.title: AI-Powered Automation
cards.description: Automation that uses AI to make decisions. Summarize this email. Classify this support ticket. Reply if it matches X.

cards.title: UI Automation
cards.description: Controlling a browser or desktop app programmatically. Useful when no API exists.

cards.title: Data Pipeline Automation
cards.description: Moving, cleaning, and transforming data between systems automatically.

cards.title: Notification Automation
cards.description: Sending alerts or updates automatically when a condition is met.
